title: REQ · An invalid NPC reference is rejected
summary: validateWorld rejects a scene NPC whose id is not in the world character list
description: Context: validateWorld pushes scenes[id].characters[i].id errors. Desired behavior: a scene with an NPC id not in world.characters yields a path-tagged error. Expected result: exact error string for the bad index only. Why: stops dangling NPC references.
acceptance_criteria: Given scene characters boy and ghost and world list boy, when validateWorld runs, then errors equal the single ghost message at index 1
Given an NPC id missing from the world, when validateWorld runs, then the result is non-empty so loading is rejected
